# @agent-a/cli

Install and configure your Agent-A AI product team in OpenCode.

## Your Team

| Role | Model | What it does |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Frontend Designer | GPT 5.6 Luna | Designs and builds clear, fast interfaces |
| Backend Hacker | DeepSeek V4 | Builds APIs, integrations, data systems, and fixes what breaks |
| Strategy + Marketing | DeepSeek V4 | Finds the angle, customer, positioning, and growth path |
| Builder + QA | GPT 5.6 Luna | Turns plans into working output and catches problems before users do |

## Quick Start

**Don't have an API key?** Get one free at **https://agenta.chat/setup**

```bash
npx @agent-a/cli init
```

When prompted, paste your Agent-A API key.

### With API key flag

```bash
npx @agent-a/cli init --api-key your_agenta_key_here
```

## Commands

```bash
npx @agent-a/cli init     # Install your team in OpenCode
npx @agent-a/cli test     # Test your Agent-A API connection
npx @agent-a/cli models   # List available Agent-A roles
npx @agent-a/cli help     # Show help
```

## What it does

1. Prompts for your Agent-A API key (or accepts `--api-key`)
2. Detects your OpenCode config at `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`
3. Backs up existing config before making changes
4. Merges the Agent-A provider into your config
5. Adds all four Agent-A models
6. Tests the connection
7. Prints your installed teammates

## Requirements

- Node.js >= 14
- OpenCode installed
- Agent-A API key (get one at https://agenta.chat/setup)
